prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide 2:1 presentation diagram explaining communication between an LLM, an agent app's MCP client, and an MCP server.
Style: restrained editorial print diagram matching warm paper technology slides. Warm light ivory #F8F5EE background, fine paper grain, near-black ink, muted teal #A3CFCB, pale yellow #FFE234, vermilion #E5432F used sparingly. Flat front-on precise diagram, bold clean Archivo-like sans-serif labels, no photos, robots, decorative scraps, no computer window chrome, no 3D.
Draw a precise SEQUENCE DIAGRAM with exactly THREE columns. Headers at top: LEFT "LLM" on pale yellow rectangular paper; CENTER "Client" with smaller subtitle "Agent app" on muted teal rectangular paper; RIGHT "MCP server" on ivory outlined rectangular paper. One thin vertical dashed lifeline descends from each header. All communication goes through the CENTER Client; no direct arrow between LLM and MCP server.
Exactly SEVEN horizontal arrows in distinct rows, from top to bottom:
1. CENTER Client to RIGHT MCP server, arrow points RIGHT, label "List tools".
2. RIGHT MCP server to CENTER Client, arrow points LEFT, label "Tool definitions".
3. CENTER Client to LEFT LLM, arrow points LEFT, label "Tool definitions".
4. LEFT LLM to CENTER Client, arrow points RIGHT, label "Tool name + inputs".
5. CENTER Client to RIGHT MCP server, arrow points RIGHT, label "Call tool".
6. RIGHT MCP server to CENTER Client, arrow points LEFT, label "Result".
7. CENTER Client to LEFT LLM, arrow points LEFT, label "Result".
Each arrow spans only the named adjacent columns. Arrows are straight, horizontal, crisp, with unmistakable arrowheads at the destination. Labels sit above their own arrows with clear whitespace. Use black arrows except row 4 and row 5 in vermilion. No additional arrows, no diagonal lines, no overlapping labels. Keep all seven rows in the EXACT order. Avoid visible row numbers. A small single caption below diagram: "Tool definitions = name, purpose, inputs". No other text, no slide title, no footer, no logos or watermark. Large readable labels, balanced margins.
